name: Spicy Green Chicken & Rice "Swamp" Soup with Spinach, Ginger & Fresh Herbs

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 jalapeño pepper
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 lime

instructions.primary_message: Place broth in a large pot, cover, and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
While the broth heats up, roughly chop parsley (including stems). Place in a blender.
Trim and roughly chop green onions. Add to the blender.

Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Roughly chop and add to the blender. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and roughly chop ginger; peel and roughly chop garlic. Add both to the blender along with miso paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 clove garlic
1 tbsp miso paste, white

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is boiling, add spinach to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just wilted, about 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer spinach to the blender. (Reserve pot with broth for later use.)

Blend spinach mixture on high until bright green and smooth, scraping down the sides of the blender as needed, about 30 seconds. Set aside. (If needed, add a splash of broth from the pot to loosen the mixture.)
Place chicken on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (532 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain.

Return pot (with broth) to high heat, then add shredded chicken and rice; cover and bring to a boil. Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until rice is just tender, about 15 minutes.

Juice lime into the pot, then add the spinach mixture, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors blend and rice is cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp soy sauce
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and enjoy!
